title: Adversarial Robustness of Camera-Radar Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Driving

problem.summary: Autonomous driving (AD) relies on multiple sensors, such as cameras, radars, LiDARs, and ultrasonic sensors, to perceive and understand the surrounding environment.

background.summary: However, an open question remains: "are radar-camera sensor fusion systems robust under adversarial driving scenarios?" To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has systematically evaluated the robustness of radar-camera fusion algorithms.
